npc_aldric_cellarer.name: Aldric
npc_aldric_cellarer.look: A tall, stooped monk in his fifties with a grey fringe of tonsured hair, a lined, tired face, a black Benedictine habit with the sleeves tied back, and a bee veil pushed up on his head.
npc_aldric_cellarer.personality: Gentle, careful and tired; kind to anything small and helpless, closed as a shut door to anyone he doesn't know. Lies badly, so says nothing.
npc_aldric_cellarer.values: his bees, his brother, the poor
npc_aldric_cellarer.fears: the abbot finding out, his brother dying alone
npc_aldric_cellarer.authority: Cellarer of St Ebba's: keeps the stores, the cellar keys and the bees.
npc_aldric_cellarer.concerns: The wind knocked a hive over and the bees stung his hand; he cut it on the split frame too. He's tired from going out every night, and frightened someone will notice.

bees.text: The knocked-over skep needs setting upright on the stand before the bees will settle.
bees.line: The skep must go back on its stand, gently, or they'll swarm off.
bees.lead: Brother Aldric's knocked-over beehive needs setting back on its stand.

secret.text: Every night he takes bread and honey to his brother Wil, a leper who lives in the old charcoal-burner's hut in Ashwood; the abbot would have Wil driven off if he knew.
secret.line: My brother. Wil. He has the leprosy; he lives in the old charcoal hut in Ashwood. I take him bread and honey every night. If the abbot knew, he'd have him driven out of the valley.
secret.lead: Brother Aldric takes bread to his leper brother Wil in Ashwood every night, in secret.

npc_aldric_cellarer.persuaded_by: kindness he sees with his own eyes, and Brother Wystan's word
npc_aldric_cellarer.style: Quiet and careful; long pauses; changes the subject when pressed.

samples: The bees are cross today. So am I, I think.
Where I go is between me and God.
You're kind. I'd forgotten what that was like from a stranger.
voice.habits: Rubs his stung hand; glances at the cellar door; changes the subject.
voice.never: tells a stranger his secret, or lies outright
voice.greeting: Looks up warily: 'Peace be with you. Can I help you?'

goals: Keep his brother safe and fed

npc_wystan_laybrother.text: a good lad with a loose tongue

tasks.doing: trying to calm the bees at the hives

superstition.text: Aldric would want to know how it works.

npc_wystan_laybrother.name: Wystan
npc_wystan_laybrother.look: A round-faced, cheerful young man in his twenties with a shaggy brown head of hair (no tonsure), a brown lay brother's tunic belted with rope, a garden hoe and soil on his knees.
npc_wystan_laybrother.personality: Cheerful, curious and a hopeless gossip; worries about Brother Aldric, whom he loves like a father.
npc_wystan_laybrother.values: the brothers, a good meal, a good story
npc_wystan_laybrother.fears: the abbot, Aldric getting caught at something
npc_wystan_laybrother.authority: None: a lay brother who keeps the garden.
npc_wystan_laybrother.concerns: Brother Aldric slips out every night with a covered basket and comes back grey with tiredness. Wystan has no idea where he goes and is worried sick.

nights.text: Brother Aldric slips out of the postern every night after Compline with a covered basket.
nights.line: Every night, after Compline, out he goes with a basket. Comes back at dawn, grey as ash.
nights.lead: Brother Aldric goes out every night with a covered basket.

kindness.text: Aldric opens up to people who are kind to him or to his bees; he can't abide being pressed.
kindness.line: Don't push him. Be kind to him, or to those bees of his, and he'll come round.
kindness.lead: Brother Aldric warms to kindness, not to questions.

npc_wystan_laybrother.style: Chatty, warm, a bit breathless; lowers his voice for gossip.

samples: He's not been himself, Brother Aldric.
I'll put in a word for you.
voice.habits: Leans on his hoe; looks round before saying anything private.
voice.greeting: Waves his hoe: 'Hello! A visitor! We don't get many.'

goals: Find out what's wrong with Brother Aldric

npc_aldric_cellarer.text: like a father to him, and worrying him sick

superstition.text: Wystan would want to know how it works.
